description: Virtual cat care game for Luna (3yo). Pink/pastel aesthetic, big touch targets for iPad. Goal: make it more fun, engaging, and add age-appropriate learning features.

ideas: Dress-up/costumes: hats, bows, accessories for the cat
Counting game: feed the cat 1-5 fish, count along with emoji
Surprise eggs: tap to reveal what's inside (shapes, colors, animals)
upgrades.summary: Added 3 new features: (1) Dress-up mode with 9 accessories (crown, bow, flower, star, butterfly, rainbow, gem, hat, hibiscus) that appear on the cat and persist across sessions. (2) Counting fish mini-game — cat asks for 1-5 fish, Luna taps fish to fill slots, celebrates on completion, auto-starts next round. Teaches counting 1-5. (3) Surprise eggs — 3 colorful eggs that shake when tapped and crack open after 3 taps to reveal animals, colors, or shapes with labels. All features have sound feedback, big touch targets, and emoji celebrations.

ideas: Bubble pop mini-game: tap floating bubbles with letters/numbers
Dance party mode: cat dances when all needs are full, fun music
Animal friends: other animals visit (teaches animal names/sounds)
upgrades.summary: Added 3 new features: (1) Bubble Pop — colorful translucent bubbles float up with letters (A-E), numbers (1-5), and fun emoji inside. Tap to pop them with satisfying sound + burst effects. Every 5 pops triggers a celebration. Teaches letter/number recognition through play. (2) Dance Party — cat dances with emoji friends on a rainbow background with floating disco balls, musical beat sounds, and tap-to-burst effects on each dancer. Pure joy and sensory delight. (3) Animal Friends — 6 random animals visit the cat. Each tap brings an animal with its unique sound (woof, ribbit, quack, etc.) and greeting. Teaches animal names and sounds. Celebration when all friends are visited.

ideas: Color matching mini-game: tap the color the cat asks for (teaches colors)
Cat bath time: splash animations, rubber ducky, water sounds
Peek-a-boo: cat hides behind objects, tap to find it (object permanence)
upgrades.summary: Added 3 new features: (1) Color Match — cat shows a color heart and asks Luna to find it among 4 choices. Correct picks celebrate with bursts + score. Wrong picks wobble gently. Teaches color names and recognition. (2) Bath Time — interactive bath scene with 6 wash items (sponge, shampoo, bubbles, rubber ducky, rinse, splash). Tap items to wash the cat with splash effects and floating bubbles. 5 steps to complete a bath = sparkly clean cat + max cleanliness. (3) Peek-a-Boo — kitty hides behind 3-6 objects (trees, boxes, clouds). Tap to find! Wrong spots show a shy emoji, correct spot reveals the happy cat. Difficulty increases as you score more. Teaches object permanence.

ideaPool: Shape recognition: cat plays with different shaped toys, name the shape
ABC letters: cat finds letters around the house, tap to learn the letter sound
Day/night cycle: background changes based on time, teaches time of day
Cat mood expressions: more varied emoji faces with labeled emotions (teaches feelings)
Mini sticker collection: earn stickers for good care streaks
Weather effects: rain/sun/snow on background (teaches weather words)
Garden scene: plant flowers with the cat, watch them grow (patience/nature)
Cat wardrobe: unlock new cat colors/patterns as rewards
Lullaby mode: gentle music and stars when putting cat to sleep
Feeding variety: multiple food types with names (teaches food vocabulary)
Happy meter celebration: confetti + special animation when cat is at max happiness
Touch trail sparkles: draw sparkle trails with finger
Sound board: cat makes different sounds based on mood
Simple puzzle: 2-4 piece jigsaw of the cat
Memory card game: flip cards to match cat-themed pairs
Rainbow bridge: trace rainbow arcs for the cat to walk across
Seasons mode: spring/summer/fall/winter backgrounds with themed activities
Music maker: tap different items to make musical sounds, play simple tunes
